description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Consumer Affairs Authority Act No. 09 of 2003 (Direction Under Section 10 (I) (a) )
reasoning: This gazette contains a direction issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under Section 10(1)(a) of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes regulatory requirements for receipts/bills/invoices that must be maintained by manufacturers, producers, store owners, suppliers, distributors, or traders. This constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement, falling under Legal/Regulatory classification. While it mentions an individual (Maj. Gen. Shantha Dissanayake) in a signing capacity, this does not constitute a government personnel appointment or change, and the core content is regulatory in nature.
